decisions.reasoning: The only failing gate-level finding right now is picture_area: the recorded picture is only 480×404 pixels sitting inside a 1280×720 file at offset +400+158 — it is heavily pillarboxed/letterboxed and must be cropped to the actual picture content before any composite can be attempted. The fix.reframe strategy explicitly addresses "picture_area" and "subject_size". Subject size is already passing (p50 0.338, p95 0.344 shoulder span, well under the 0.55 cap) and distance is steady (1.06×), so the reframe just needs to crop the padding and set the head target to 0.334 within the allowed head_target_max of 0.55 and scale_tol of 0.25. The headroom warning (crown outside picture on 34 % of frames) is a recorded-content limit, not a defect the fixer can invent content to fix — it is noted for the report only. No process attempt has been made yet (attempts_so_far is empty), and the retry budget is at 2, so spending one fix here is well within budget. If this fix fails to resolve picture_area (e.g. the crop produces an output that still fails a gate), the next step would be to run process.standard; if gates still fail after that with no remaining strategies, the exit would be reshoot with guidance on exporting without padding.

All inspection findings are either passing or warnings (recorded-content limits, not defects to fix). Specifically: picture_area passes, pose_coverage is 1.0 (gate requires ≥0.6), one_subject is 1.0 (gate requires ≥0.95), subject_size p50 0.338 and p95 0.344 are both well under the 0.55 cap, and distance_steady is 1.06 (≤1.35). The headroom finding (34% of frames with crown outside picture) and face_exposure (held at ×0.80) are both warnings — recorded-content limits noted for the report, not gate-blocking defects. No gate failures are present in current_findings; latest_verification is null because no process attempt has been made yet. The fix.reframe has already been applied (decision 1), so the correct next step is to render the first process attempt using process.standard, the standard strategy for a first attempt. The retry budget is 2 with 0 reprocesses used. If process.standard produces a verification that fails separation, process.separation_targeted remains available as a fallback; if both are exhausted with failures, reshoot is the exit.

The latest verification for attempt_1 (process.standard) passed every gate: pose_coverage 1.0 ≥ 0.6, one_subject 1.0 ≥ 0.95, matte_extent 1.016 ≥ 0.9, separation 2.36 ≥ 1.5, head_spread 0.007 ≤ 0.02, head_drift 1.9 px ≤ 4.0 px, frame_count 1800 = 1800, and audio_md5 equal. All eight gates are green with no failures. The two open items — headroom warning (crown outside picture on 34 % of frames) and face_exposure warning (gain held at ×0.80) — are recorded-content limits flagged as warnings, not gate failures, and the rules explicitly say warnings are not defects to fix. No gate is failing, the retry budget has not been spent, and the artifact passed its verification, so the correct and only honest action is to deliver.
